value.name: Daniel offers to secure Rosa's future
value.description: Daniel offers to make an arrangement that would protect Rosa's security even though the house situation is unresolved.
evidence: not yet know whether we will keep the house and I do not want your security to depend on a question that has not been answered. Would you let me do that.

value.name: Rosa agrees conditionally
value.description: Rosa says she would accept Daniel's offer, but only if he follows a specific condition.
evidence: "I would let you do that," she said. "On one condition."

value.name: Rosa demands a lawyer-mediated agreement
value.description: Rosa insists the arrangement be handled through a lawyer approved by Daniel's sister so it is not kept secret from Lucia.
evidence: "That you do it through your sister's lawyer. I do not mean Asha. I mean a different lawyer, one your sister approves of, so that the agreement is not a thing you and I have done between us in secret and so that Lucia knows from the start that it exists and what it says.

value.name: Rosa rejects another family secret
value.description: Rosa explains that she has spent decades being kept secret within the family and refuses to begin another secret arrangement.
evidence: "I have spent thirty-one years being a secret between members of this family in one way or another. I am too old to start a new secret today."

value.name: Daniel agrees to Rosa's condition
value.description: Daniel accepts Rosa's requirement that the agreement be handled openly through the proper lawyer.

value.name: Rosa thanks Daniel and asks for time
value.description: Rosa thanks Daniel for the offer but says she is not yet sure she wants the room and needs a week to think about it.
evidence: "Thank you. For the offer. I want you to know I am thanking you for it before I tell you the other thing, which is that I do not know yet whether I want the room.

"I have lived in my own apartment on Catharine Street for thirty-one years and I have a life there I have made by myself and that no one in your family has ever seen, and the offer to come and live in the room I cleaned for thirty-one years is an offer I want to think about, because the answer to it is not as obvious as it might appear to you. So I am asking you for what you asked your sister for. I am asking you for the week."

value.name: Daniel grants Rosa a week
value.description: Daniel gives Rosa the week she requested to decide whether she wants the room.

value.name: Daniel and Rosa share a quiet pause
value.description: They drink coffee in silence for a while after reaching their temporary understanding.
evidence: They drank their coffee. They did not say anything else for some time.

value.name: Daniel prepares to leave
value.description: At ten to four, Daniel stands, puts on his coat, and looks down at Rosa before speaking again.
evidence: At ten to four Daniel stood and put on his coat and looked down at her.
